title: Built a browser combat-farming roguelite inspired by childhood flash games
author: Thicthor96
selftext:
I grew up grinding browser games during computer lab when I was supposed to be doing schoolwork. A few weeks ago, I set out to recreate that specific loop: fast combat, addictive progression, and deep gear customization.

The main loop is pretty straightforward. You farm plants, forge them into gear sets with random affix rolls, and take that build into a 30-floor tower called the Thornspire.

Every 5 floors you get an extraction choice: bank your mats and play it safe, or push higher & attempt the tower boss for mythic loot. 

I don’t come from a traditional game dev background, so I’ve been using Claude and GPT as pair programmers and prototyping tools to piece together the mechanics and assets bit by bit. Right now the full combat loop and gear math are working. The immediate next step is taking the rough sprite animations through Blender to get the attack frames looking clean and fluid.

Curious what you guys think of the combat layout and UI readability so far. Feedback on the pacing is welcome!

comments.author: GoGs0l0dev
comments.body:
I am not hesitant to say something looks like absolute shit on this sub and I do it regularly.

This has one major flaw to me that can be corrected.  It’s too menu/text heavy, for example 2:24 and onward.  That battle could give someone a seizure.

I think this has a lot of potential but needs a UI overhaul.

replies.author: Thicthor96
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback! I will take a look at minimizing the default presentation. I do have toggleable vfx settings and a cinematic mode that turns off  pretty much everything. Boss passives I could reduce down to icons with hoverable tooltips. What other feedback do you have?!

replies.author: GoGs0l0dev
replies.body: Nothing else.  That’s the major thing.  UI/frontend design is a major part of my professional life, and simplifying it down can prevent turning off some players.

This brings back memories of the old Flash game days!! I really love the concept!

I thought some extra sound effects could make the combat feel even more satisfying, so I tried adding some sounds to a short section of your gameplay! Hope you like it! ╰(\*°▽°\*)╯

replies.author: Thicthor96
replies.body: I do!!! How did you do this sorcery? I like these sounds effects much more than what’s in the game currently 🙂

replies.author: Silver-Second-647
replies.body:
Thank you so much!! That seriously means a lot! :D

I actually built CICA because I was struggling with sound design in my own game. It analyzes gameplay videos, figures out when and where sound effects are needed, and generates sounds to match what's happening on screen.

I'm really happy you liked the results! If you'd like, I'd be more than happy to share the individual sound effects so you can use them in your game! :)
